title: solve.fluid: final_max_speed is reported in m/s next to max_speed in display units
body:
`solve.fluid` reports `final_max_speed` in SI (m/s) while `max_speed` next to it is in the display units, so in mm-t-s-N-MPa the two differ by a factor of 1000.

**Repro** (develop 3751d3b, `fieldcraft-cli mcp --headless`, CPU or GPU):
```json
{"command":"file.sample","params":{"name":"flow-past"}}
{"command":"solve.fluid","params":{"step":"Flow","backend":"gpu"}}
```
Reply: `"max_speed": 41.693` (mm/s), `"final_max_speed": 0.039287`. The last frame's real peak is 39.287 mm/s: `results.frame {frame: 10}` then `results.contour {field: "velocity"}` gives a max of 39.28715890097606.

**Cause:** the `solve.fluid` reply table in `crates/engine/src/units.rs` (around line 513) lists `/max_speed` but not `/final_max_speed`, so it's left in SI. `/max_speed_time` is missing too. It reads correctly in seconds only because every display system uses seconds today.

**Fix:** add `("/final_max_speed", Dim::Velocity)` and `("/max_speed_time", Dim::Time)`, plus a test that converts a fluid reply into mm-t-s-N-MPa and checks both. Both keys came in with 7fd5348 (#590).
